query:
-- Encontrar o CEO TESTE 1
SELECT c.id as ceo_id, c.name, me.id as element_id
FROM ceos c
JOIN map_elements me ON me.type = 'ceo' AND me.referenceId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%TESTE 1%' OR c.name LIKE '%TEST 1%' OR c.name LIKE '%TEST1%'
LIMIT 5;
